source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Produces a trance-like state with sedation, amnesia, and analgesia while maintaining airway reflexes better than many other agents","B":"Fairly minimal sedative properties overall compared with other agents typically chosen for procedural sedation","C":"A fairly uniform loss of protective airway reflexes similar to what deeper general anesthesia would typically produce","D":"Use reserved mainly for chronic pain management rather than for short-term procedural sedation purposes"}}
source_row.rationale: Ketamine is a dissociative anesthetic producing a trance-like state with sedation, amnesia, and analgesia, generally maintaining airway reflexes and respiratory drive better than many other sedative-hypnotic agents.
